title: Saudi-Houthi Conflict and Oil Prices (Trump Oil Deal, Yemen)
summary: Gotrade News - Oil prices eased on Tuesday after topping $106 a barrel a day earlier, as traders weighed the escalating Saudi-Houthi conflict against
body_markdown:
Asked whether the US would join Saudi strikes on the Houthis, President Donald Trump said: "We may. We're going to look at it." He added that "what happened in Saudi Arabia's not acceptable," according to[The Times of Israel](https://www.timesofisrael.com/dozens-hurt-as-houthis-hit-riyadh-airport-trump-us-may-join-saudi-strikes/) .


## Saudi Energy Minister Says Exports Are Not at Risk


Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman sought to calm markets, saying there is no danger to oil exports from the kingdom, per[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Retreat-as-Saudi-Arabia-Pledges-to-Keep-Exports-Flowing.html) . Speaking at the WPC Energy Congress on Monday, he said resilience "must also be measured by the ability to continue delivering under pressure," a remark first quoted by Bloomberg.


> "Energy resilience is beyond barrels of spare capacity, of pipelines and gigawatts of generation." Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman, Saudi Energy Minister, as quoted by Bloomberg via Oilprice.com


Supply risks remain in focus. According to[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Jumps-2-as-Saudi-Attacks-and-Tanker-Strikes-Revive-Hormuz-Fears.html) , the tanker attacks threaten the recovery in Gulf oil exports, which reached 81% of prewar levels in September, with crude and condensate at 91% but refined products at only 60%.


## Trump's Russian Diesel Deal and Goldman's $90 Brent Call


On the supply side, Trump said on Friday that Russia would immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel, or about 2.25 million barrels, with more to follow, as reported by[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Jumps-2-as-Saudi-Attacks-and-Tanker-Strikes-Revive-Hormuz-Fears.html) .


The deal's total volume is 4.8 million tons, but analysts say that is far too small to move pump prices for long, and some members of Congress argue it violates sanctions on Russia, per[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Prices-Retreat-as-Saudi-Arabia-Pledges-to-Keep-Exports-Flowing.html) .


Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent forecast to $90 a barrel from $85 and estimates that geopolitical risks are adding just over $20 a barrel to current prices, according to[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Jumps-2-as-Saudi-Attacks-and-Tanker-Strikes-Revive-Hormuz-Fears.html) .


Separately, OPEC Secretary General Haitham Al Ghais said 2026 oil demand growth is now expected at 400,000 barrels per day, down from 1.4 million at the start of the year.

## Gulf of Mexico Restart for Chevron, Shell and BP


For US-listed energy majors, the week also brought operational news.[Chevron (CVX)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/cvx/) ,[Shell (SHEL)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/shel/) and[BP (BP)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/bp/) were preparing to restore Gulf of Mexico offshore production after Hurricane Isaias disrupted operations over the weekend, according to[Oilprice.com](https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/Oil-Jumps-2-as-Saudi-Attacks-and-Tanker-Strikes-Revive-Hormuz-Fears.html) .
